decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Following approval for demolition of existing buildings to rear and erection of a total of 9 buildings comprising 5 No 2-4 storey buildings towards the north-eastern boundary, 3 no 5-7 storey buildings in the central rear portion of the site and one two to two and a half storey buildings towards the rear portion of the south-western boundary.  These buildings to contain 11 three bedroom houses, 3 four bedroom houses, 8 five bedroom houses, 18 one bedroom flats, 77 two bedroom flats and 2 three bedroom flats with associated landscaping, parking, play area and the provision of publicly accessible open land to the rear. 36 of the housing units (blocks D, K and L) would be provided as affordable housing - details submitted pursuant to condition 12 (screening) of approved DOE permission dated 24/1/03
